fields.description: Existing integration that owns this channel's credentials. VK and WeCom gateways require it; use its Password credential rows for the adapter's documented keys.
fields.label: Connected integration

fields.description: The least-privileged Huf user used when this gateway starts an Agent or Flow. Never use Administrator.
fields.label: Run as user

fields.description: Direct messages are denied unless an approved Gateway Access Entry matches. Pairing creates a pending request but never executes the triggering message.
fields.label: Direct-message policy

fields.description: Rooms/channels are denied unless an approved room access entry matches.
fields.label: Room policy

fields.description: Applies after room admission. Direct-message pairing never grants room access.
fields.label: Room sender policy

fields.description: Reply to the sender with their pairing code automatically. Turn off for channels where an automated reply isn't wanted (e.g. shared Email/SMS inboxes) -- the pending Gateway Access Entry is still created either way.
fields.label: Send pairing code reply
When no route matches, send to

fields.description: Optional Decision Policy that classifies each inbound message before it reaches the target Agent or Flow. Its single select question must use exactly the option ids 'spam' and 'no_agent_needed'; any other answer is treated as 'continue normally'. Leave blank to skip pre-filtering.
fields.label: Pre-filter policy

fields.description: Off: the pre-filter never runs. Shadow: runs in the background for review only and never drops, replies, or delays this message. Enforce: 'spam' rejects the event with an audit trail and 'no_agent_needed' sends the canned reply below instead of routing to the Agent/Flow. Any error, timeout, or unrecognized answer falls back to routing the message exactly as if this were Off.
fields.label: Pre-filter mode

fields.description: Sent back to the sender when Enforce mode classifies the message as not needing an agent. Leave blank to route the message through normally in that case instead of staying silent.
fields.label: 'No agent needed' reply
